trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then side missions, collectibles, activities, and the cleanup feats last — and this one arrives on its own. If it does not pop, check the tracker: one trophy is still unchecked somewhere.
steps: Follow the five roadmap stages in order, top to bottom.
Clear every missable trophy on your first pass through the story.
Leave the grind trophies (stunts, vehicles, money) for the cleanup stage.

steps: Start a new game and play the opening sequence.
Follow the mission prompts for Gone Fishing to the end.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: This gold trophy is the game's own completion counter: reach 100% in the in-game stats and it pops. It is a late-game trophy by design — story, side missions, collectibles and activities all feed the counter, so treat it as a progress check rather than a task of its own. Open the in-game stats regularly to see which category is still short, then work that category in the cleanup stage.
steps: Finish the story, side missions and stranger strands first.
Check the in-game completion stats to find the lagging category.
Clear that category, then re-check until the counter reads 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts build up across everything you do in a vehicle — jumps, near misses, airtime and similar feats all count toward the 250. There is no single spot to grind: just drive hard and the counter climbs in the background while you play. For the last stretch, find a good jump spot and repeat clean runs, since a failed landing usually breaks the chain.
steps: Drive aggressively during normal play; stunts count automatically.
Watch the stunt counter in the in-game stats.
For the final stretch, repeat a reliable jump until you reach 250.

Work through the activity list early in the activity stage so you know which types exist, then chase the deeper activity trophies after.
steps: Open the activities list and note the 9 types.
Try each type once — no win or completion needed.
The trophy pops after the ninth type.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.target: Gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges
trophies.guide: The Shooting Range holds 42 challenges, and this silver trophy needs a gold medal in every one of them. It is the longest skill grind in the activity stage, so do not leave it to the very end — practice a few challenges between story beats instead. Learn each challenge's scoring first with a bronze or silver run, then go back for gold once you know the targets and the timing.
steps: Visit a Shooting Range and open the challenge list.
Clear each challenge once to learn its targets and timing.
Return for gold medals one challenge at a time until all 42 are gold.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the key word is different, so repeating your favourite race does not move the counter. Work through the race list across the map, picking a fresh race each time, and use a fast, stable vehicle you trust. Races you have already won are easy to spot on the map, so plan a route that sweeps up the unwon ones.

Win it, then move to the next unwon race.
Repeat until 20 different races are won.

trophies.guide: Leonida has 52 named areas, and this trophy needs you to visit every one of them. The map's fog or area list shows what is left, so finish the last few areas deliberately at the end of the exploration stage.

Expect a fight at each site, so go in prepared.

Rob one illegal operation for a gang.
Repeat for all 9 gangs, tallying each one.
